Faster, tidier and more self-updating.

- **Automatic sync**: new SMS from your selected bank threads are imported when you open the app and every 6 hours in the background. Turn it off or see the last sync time in Settings. Only the threads you chose are read, and nothing leaves the phone.
- **Merchant cleanup**: spellings of the same shop ("AMAZON.SA", "Amazon SA Riyadh", "AMZN Mktp"; Arabic variants too) become one merchant, so totals, top merchants, category corrections and duplicate detection work across them. Use **Same merchant as…** on a transaction to merge merchants yourself, and **Undo merges** to reverse it.
- **Category confidence**: the transaction detail shows how sure the app is ("Shopping · 62% match").
- **Needs review**: Activity flags transactions with a low-confidence category, an unknown merchant or an unconfirmed card/account, and a **Needs review** chip lists them. Home shows how many need attention.
- **Faster imports**: re-importing reads only new messages; duplicate checks and the Settings screens no longer slow down with a long SMS history.
- Existing transactions are re-read once on first launch after updating. Your corrections, labels and card/account answers are kept.

APK: arm64-v8a, built and signed by GitHub Actions.
